the engine's subtree walk nests each child's subtree before the next sibling
notes: Measured: the default-order case (tests/PendingSchema.test.ts:1569) is a linear chain, so sibling sequence and pre-order are both unpinned, and 9b72a4d0 moved the order with nothing red.
